people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
translations.bsb: For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.
translations.kjv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
translations.asv: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God afore prepared that we should walk in them.
